description: Saves the text as the reply draft of a received email, from the address the email was written to (a brand address or the mailbox). needsIdentity: that address cannot send until the user verifies it in BumbleBox. Nothing is sent: the draft waits in BumbleBox (Pilotage › prepared replies) until the user reviews it and clicks Send. Saving again replaces the previous draft of the same email.
